# Manthan Ankolekar's Portfolio

> Personal portfolio website of Manthan Ankolekar, a full-stack software engineer working in Next.js, Angular, Node.js and Python. Based in Karnataka, India.

## About

Full-stack software engineer with 3.5+ years of experience building scalable web applications, microservices and AI-driven workflows. I work mostly in Next.js, Angular, Node.js and Python on cloud-native infrastructure. My recent work covers integrations with dealer management systems, LLM vision pipelines and high-throughput SaaS dashboards.

I hold a B.E. in Computer Science & Engineering from Sahyadri College of Engineering & Management, Mangalore (Aug 2016 - Aug 2020).

**Key Technologies**: JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, Next.js, React, Angular, RxJS, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express.js, Flask, RabbitMQ, WebSockets, MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Firebase, Supabase, Redis, Anthropic Claude API, OpenAI, Docker, AWS, GCP, Microsoft Azure

**Availability**: Open to full-time roles and freelance projects, remote or on-site.

**Work history**:
- Software Developer, Tech Driven Agency (Feb 2025 - Oct 2026, Remote)
- Software Developer, Senwell Group Pvt Ltd (Oct 2024 - Jan 2025, Pune)
- Software Engineer, BlackCoffer (Feb 2023 - Aug 2024, Remote)
- Full Stack Developer Intern, AppiVa Software Pvt Ltd (Jul 2022 - Dec 2022, Remote)
- Angular Developer Intern, Faclon Labs Pvt Ltd (Nov 2021 - Apr 2022, Mumbai, Remote)

**Community**: 140 articles on Dev.to, 16 npm packages, 105 open learning guides in TheLearningHubOrg.

- [Weather Apps](https://github.com/manthanank/weather-app-angular): Multiple weather applications built with Angular and PWA technologies
